spotify_password = next(p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='spotify')
spotify_username = 'paul_mill@gmail.com'
print('have_password', bool(spotify_password))
res = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_username, password=spotify_password)
print(res)
spotify_token = res.get('access_token')
print('token_set', bool(spotify_token))

# Fetch all albums from Spotify album library (paginated) and collect song_ids
albums = []
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page_index', page_index, 'type', type(page), 'len', (len(page) if hasattr(page, '__len__') else None))
    if not page:
        break
    albums.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_albums', len(albums))
all_song_ids = []
for a in albums:
    all_song_ids.extend(a.get('song_ids', []))
unique_song_ids = sorted(set(all_song_ids))
print('unique_song_ids', len(unique_song_ids))
print('sample_album_titles', [a.get('title') for a in albums[:5]])

arguments.code:
# Fetch play counts and titles for each unique song id from album library
song_ids = unique_song_ids
song_details = []
# determine earliest appearance index in all_song_ids list
first_index = {}
for idx, sid in enumerate(all_song_ids):
    if sid not in first_index:
        first_index[sid] = idx

for sid in song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(access_token=spotify_token, song_id=int(sid))
    song_details.append({
        'song_id': sid,
        'title': s.get('title'),
        'play_count': s.get('play_count'),
        'first_seen_idx': first_index.get(sid)
    })

# Sort by play_count desc then first_seen_idx asc then title asc
song_details_sorted = sorted(song_details, key=lambda x: (-float(x['play_count']), x['first_seen_idx'], str(x['title'])))
print('song_details_count', len(song_details_sorted))
print('top5', song_details_sorted[:5])
max_play = float(song_details_sorted[0]['play_count'])
max_candidates = [d for d in song_details_sorted if float(d['play_count'])==max_play]
print('max_play', max_play, 'candidates', len(max_candidates), max_candidates)
selected = song_details_sorted[0]
print('selected_title', selected['title'])
